content:
I am working on upstreaming https://github.com/wwylele/Feuerbach, the theorem 29 on Freek Wiedijk's list of 100 theorems. It is not a particularly hard one, so it is not that exciting at this age where people can just ask AI to generate long proofs. Still, I think this proof can bring a good batch of useful lemma to Mathlib (the recently merged simplex volume was one of them).

I haven't created the full PR tree yet. Right now I have three leaf PRs ready for review:

  • #41220: basic lemma for triangle area
  • #44060: simplex volume calculation from exradius
  • #44102: distance between an affineCombination and a fixed point

Thankfully, after the long journey of bringing volume from measure theory, the rest are all within Euclidean geometry, so they shouldn't be hard to review. It is a great chance to get more people familiar with this area of library by reviewing them.
I have a fourth leaf PR #44218 related to nine-point circle
Just a small ping for #44060 and #41220 as they have been in the maintainer-merge queue for a while, and are blocking the long pole of the dependency tree
